description.content: Machines & Files — one merged console: the machine list on the left drives a dual-pane file commander on the right (This PC ⇄ remote host), with Ping / Edit / Display / Drive redirection / Remote in the header toolbar.

File transfers over RDP drive redirection: browse both sides, drag files across the divider or use the Send/Get arrows, with live progress, throughput and ETA in a persistent transfer dock (Queue + History).
Transfers are honest end-to-end: cancel active items, one-click Retry on failures, Skip is recorded, and overwrite conflicts ask Replace / Keep both / Skip with an apply-to-all shortcut.
Go-to-path address bar on both panes: click the breadcrumb, paste a path with \ or /, Enter to navigate — validated before navigating, with friendly empty-folder and access-denied states.
Drive redirection panel per machine (all drives, specific drives, hot-plugged): maps straight to the .rdp drivestoredirect field. Turning it off honestly disables the Files console.
Machine list now shows live reachability and latency per machine, refreshed automatically.
Nocturne design system: single blurple accent, outlined buttons, compact dark theme applied consistently from one ResourceDictionary.
Report a bug from the Info tab — opens a pre-filled GitHub issue with optional diagnostics attached; no tokens stored in the app.
Real file logging at %LOCALAPPDATA%\RdpManager\logs (14-day retention), an Open-logs-folder button, and toasts that auto-hide after 3 seconds.
Security unchanged by design: passwords stay in DPAPI/Credential Manager, the generated .rdp never contains a secret, and the bug reporter and transfer engine hold no credentials.
